# Sofía: generating **actual** PNGs for all 295 wardrobe JSON entries

**Source of truth:** 14 validated garment JSON files in src/sofia/avatar/wardrobe_data. Source audit on 2026-10-16: 295 JSON entries, 244 public and 51 private. In-code built-in extras are outside this 295 count.

**Status:** Procedural starter batch, NOT 295 professional AI-generated, exact-design/rig-accepted layers. Every garment has a source-linked PNG candidate generated by src/sofia/avatar/vtuber_full_batch_art.py; garment-specific construction/graphics need art review and corrective illustration. Both source SHA and image SHA are recorded; visual_review=required and exact_source_match=false. A downloaded workflow artifact is not a deployed Sofia garment.

## Completed public batch

GitHub Actions workflow [.github/workflows/avatar2d-public-draft-assets.yml](../../.github/workflows/avatar2d-public-draft-assets.yml) runs the source-linked public generator and uploads downloadable, individual PNG files:

- 244 public garment IDs; 321 PNGs because some items require front and rear views.
- An immutable manifest preserves each original item ID, category, garment type, current source SHA, asset SHA, color, material, slots, wardrobe layer, and draft quality.
- Verified actual PNG magic, image bytes SHA and expected source IDs; the later enhanced workflow also proves visible RGBA pixels and separately uploads public character-part sprites.
- **Public image archive** is available from the corresponding successful GitHub Actions run (Artifacts section), kept for 30 days. This is not a permanent production CDN.

All public drafts can also be generated on Windows with Sofía installed:

    $Root = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "SofiaAdaLyra\Avatar2D"
    python -m sofia.avatar.vtuber_full_batch_art --public-root "$Root\public-draft-new"

Use a fresh nonempty-path-free output folder. This avoids overwriting accepted art, and needs no change to sofia.db or production host credentials.

## 51 private designs, safely separated

The private batch is intentionally **not** generated/uploaded by public GitHub Actions, source Git or the public artist preview. Doing so would expose private-only catalog information and candidate art outside private controls.

Source code supports generating the remaining 51 *garment-only* candidate PNGs locally, when a valid owner/private SAFE authorization (private_chat + adult_avatar + explicit current opt-in + no operator STOP) is resolved from the canonical sofia.db. The private output root must be separate from the public root, under owner-controlled local ACLs and not cloud-synced by default.

For an eligible, **owner-supervised** Windows session where the canonical state path and durable authorization are already established:

    # Supply the ACTUAL canonical state path in your Sofía configuration.
    $StatePath = "<your-existing-canonical-sofia.db-path>"
    $Public = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "SofiaAdaLyra\Avatar2D\public-owner-batch"
    $Private = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "SofiaAdaLyra\Avatar2D\private-owner-batch"
    python -m sofia.avatar.vtuber_full_batch_art --public-root "$Public" --private-root "$Private" --state "$StatePath" --owner-opt-in

This does not enroll a device or issue a FIDO2 credential, and it will refuse private generation when SAFE authorization is absent or revoked. These are stylized images of garments without exposed anatomy. **Generating candidate garment files is not permission for Sofía to display them in private mode.** Private rendering still requires per-frame host/session validation and private asset review.

## Face, eyes, hair, tail and ears

The avatar **base** is independent of clothing. Existing src/sofia/avatar/vtuber_character_parts.py generates separate public PNG options for face, freckles, left/right eye and eyebrow, mouth, front/back hair, left/right fox ears, and tail. This is a separate download artifact in the public batch workflow, never bundled with private garment candidates.

## Why this is a first pass, not final quality

The offline procedural renderer produces aligned transparent silhouettes and limited adornments from category, slots and canonical color/fit metadata. It does **not** reproduce professional anime fabric lighting, embroidered symbols, every specific seam, exact back graphic, expressive rig deformations or all complex private garment cuts. The owner-requested image generation fidelity needs one detailed asset-specific illustration/refinement + review for **each** source design (and extra views as required).

Therefore:
- **Public source coverage and generated files:** complete for 244 entries when GitHub Actions verification passes.
- **Private source coverage:** complete for 51 entries; actual protected export only on an authenticated, authorized local owner workstation.
- **All 295 professional, exactly source-matched, renderer-approved sprite items:** OPEN.
- **Live Venus acceptance / full GitHub package CI:** independent acceptance tasks. No Gate 4 completion inferred.
